message.content: In one of the conversations, LiHua shares a memorable moment from the game "Black Myth: Wukong." Specifically, LiHua mentions having an amazing battle scene where they had to outsmart a giant enemy. The strategy involved in this battle was so satisfying, and the graphics made it even more epic. LiHua expresses excitement about the thrilling and immersive battle, highlighting how it made every victory feel particularly rewarding. This indicates that LiHua found this moment particularly memorable due to its strategic depth and visually stunning presentation within the game.
